title: Section M: Resilience & Fault Tolerance Verification
description: Validates 3-state circuit breakers (CLOSED/OPEN/HALF-OPEN), bulkhead resource isolation, cascading timeout deadline propagation, and adaptive load shedding.

assertions.name: Circuit_Breaker_State_Machine_Transitions
assertions.message: Circuit breaker transitioned correctly: CLOSED -> OPEN -> HALF-OPEN -> CLOSED.

assertions.name: Bulkhead_Resource_Partition_Isolation
assertions.message: Bulkhead partition isolated Service A flood without degrading Service B capacity.

assertions.name: Cascading_Timeout_Deadline_Propagation
assertions.message: Timeout deadline propagated across downstream boundaries, cancelling over-budget operations.

assertions.name: Adaptive_Load_Shedding_Under_Saturation
assertions.message: Adaptive load shedding dropped 2 non-critical requests during high CPU saturation.
